disposition_reason: The C4 classification task is ordered, but the complete original confidence/coverage baseline and authenticated original panel are not recovered. The implemented animal-grouped target-blind successor changes the historical comparison and cannot establish a same-task win.

source_paper.title: A deep learning strategy to identify cell types across species from high-density extracellular recordings

evidence.locator: Figures 5C–F and 6; STAR Methods, Cell-type classification
evidence.supports: Original LOO classification, confidence/coverage, external expert-label comparison and paper/source identity.
LOO versus five-fold choices, ten runs, probability averaging and training-only oversampling.
Class ontology and waveform/ACG preparation route; current loader is not a verified original data manifest.
Engineered-feature baseline reads the target class and applies a 10 ms refractory edit specifically to PkC_cs; this requires separate calibration labeling.

evidence.locator: Scope and preserved estimands; Why the literal baseline remains separate; Evidence and qualification
evidence.supports: The local source explicitly preserves literal unit-LOO reconstruction separately from its inactive grouped target-blind successor and leaves original scientific qualification unresolved.

target.description: Five-class cerebellar cell-type prediction; external mouse and macaque expert-label agreement remains a separate panel.

dataset.description: Public C4 HDF5 release is identified, but exact paper unit/source and checkpoint membership are not authenticated here.

cohort.description: 202 ground-truth classifier units; three granule cells are excluded from classification. Preserve full external mouse/macaque panels and distinguish optogenetic truth from expert labels.

split.description: Original classifier uses leave-one-unit-out with ten initializations per unit; external predictions average all 2020 members. Animal-held-out nesting is a separate extension.

inputs.description: Waveform, 3D autocorrelogram and cerebellar layer; no-layer ablation is a distinct original condition.

preprocessing.description: Recover exact QC, alignment, VAE exposure and original checkpoint/configuration lineage. The label-conditioned engineered feature route cannot be presented as target-blind prediction.

metric.description: Per-class correct predictions among retained units, together with retained fraction. Confidence is the largest mean class probability divided by the second largest; original threshold is 2 and threshold-0 results are also reported.

aggregation.description: Preserve all classwise confusion/coverage and external population results; a single macro-score and ordered joint acceptance rule have not been source-recovered.

comparison.primary_metric: Original classwise accuracy at matched retained coverage, with full external-validation panel

published_baseline.description: The text reports greater-than-95% headline accuracy and selected classwise values, but not an authenticated complete numeric Fig. 5/6 baseline suitable for one scalar threshold. Do not substitute 0.95 for the full published comparator.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No qualified rerun of the original author comparison is established. Public source and construction code are a recovery route, not a measured comparator.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful effect must be justified for this original endpoint after recovering its numerical baseline and measurement variability; no generic percentage or significance-only victory is admitted.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired uncertainty for the complete original panel after recovering source-level dependence and replication; no final decision rule is yet qualified.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Biological animal/recording groups must be recovered; unit-LOO predictions and ten model initializations are dependent. External mouse and macaque cohorts require separate treatment.
uncertainty.rationale: Changing the evaluation partition to simplify inference would define a separate extension.

paper_win_requires: Recover the complete original class/confidence/coverage outputs and their denominators; define an ordered comparison before candidate results are observed.
Retain the original LOO and external population regimes with matched input and VAE exposure; compare accuracy without obtaining a gain by discarding more units.
Use the full released author comparator, preserving disclosure of label-conditioned engineered-feature preprocessing; do not replace it with the local grouped reference.
Report descriptive behavioral analyses separately; changed animal/laboratory splits or a target-blind preprocessing successor cannot count as surpassing the original result.
Require a task-justified improvement and valid biological-dependence uncertainty, not repeated-seed significance.

current_sota.description: Surpassing this source paper is distinct from current SOTA; no contemporary competitor survey or SOTA result is asserted.

episode.improvement_loop: Once the original C4 panel and exposure policy are recovered, iterate using only each original LOO fit’s training units and separately declared development feedback. Keep all observations of the left-out unit out of fitting and preserve the permitted unlabeled VAE corpus. Log classifier, probability calibration and confidence-rule changes without feeding external mouse/macaque evaluation labels into selection.
episode.candidate_freeze: Before final LOO and transfer scoring, freeze the five-class ontology, complete unit roster, original QC and input conditions, VAE membership and initialization, per-fold fit recipe, ten-member probability reduction, confidence/coverage comparison, and budgets. The confidence threshold cannot be changed after seeing final labels to discard errors.
episode.final_evaluation: Produce the complete original 202-unit LOO and external expert-population outputs with the recovered source recipe; report every class’s accuracy and retained fraction at the original confidence conditions. Admit victory only under a predeclared ordered comparison that prevents selective coverage gains. Grouped animal-held-out results are a separately named extension.
episode.baseline_policy: Calibrate against the released author deep-classifier and its full confidence/coverage results. Preserve any label-conditioned engineered-feature baseline as a disclosed literal reconstruction; the local target-blind grouped successor cannot replace the paper comparator. Published figures, author reruns and prospective grouped references retain separate identities.

blocking_issues: Exact original release/unit census, VAE/checkpoint membership and complete figure baseline remain unbound.
Full original QC/preprocessing and current-source-to-paper equivalence require qualification.
Animal/recording dependencies and original external truth provenance must be resolved before uncertainty can be admitted.
No qualified original evaluator/rerun, meaningful-effect rule or fixed access/resource budget exists.

legacy.notes: The existing C4 source contains literal LOO reconstruction and an inactive prospective grouped target-blind route. Both remain intact; source checks and probability-capture engineering do not demonstrate improved classification.
